title: Norm bound for a Gaussian Fourier integral
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, $a\in\mathbb R$, $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb C$, and $x\in\mathbb R^n$. With $\gamma$ denoting standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, one has
\[
\left\|\int e^{i a\sum_{j=1}^n t_jx_j}f(t)\,d\gamma(t)\right\|
\leq \int\|f(t)\|\,d\gamma(t).
\]
